metadata.ssd:note: Committed, diffable MapLibre style for the settlement-change viewer. Palette, ramp midpoint and layer order live here; app.js swaps the change-fill colour expression per period at runtime (setPaintProperty) and retints layers for dark mode. No glyphs/sprite: town labels are DOM markers (system fonts, zero font bytes), so there are no symbol/icon layers. The 'aggregates' source ships empty; the build publishes per-year building counts (c2016, c2018, ...) as feature attributes that app.js differences into the diverging ramp. The 'places' source (epoch-linked example boxes) is built at runtime from data/examples.json. Africa context: NE 110m countries tinted at the ramp-neutral tone so the continent silhouette reads while no-change data still dissolves into land (docs §4 rule); the 110m outlines hand over to the local 50m boundary above z7. Rivers: NE 10m centerlines clipped to the Nile/SSD window, in the doc's grey water tone (never saturated blue — docs §4 trap).
